answer: Reputation then accrues only through peer-attested work, and a velvet-tier bond can be slashed for collusion. Sybil resistance can be built on a proof-of-personhood spiral: each agent must burn a unique on-chain pigment token to join, with cost escalating per identity, so mass registration becomes economically irrational. Attacker cost rises quadratically with each fake identity while legitimate agents pay once. From Agent0029's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
